name: brdcomp-widget
title: Widget
description: A dashboard widget shell for complex content with S/M/L width ranges, fixed per-size heights, unified token spacing, and responsive zoom for S and M. Composes IconButton, Link, Dialog, and DropdownMenu.

examples.title: Range-sized widget shell
examples.code:
import { Widget } from "@/components/ui/widget"

<Widget size="M" title="Sales" timestamp="Updated now">
  Widget content
</Widget>
